notes.title: Circuit Breakout: Official Steam Launch!
notes.notes:
The moment we've all been waiting for has arrived - Circuit Breakout is now officially launched on Steam! We're incredibly excited to share the result of our team's hard work, creativity, and dedication with all of you.

Navigate the complex maze of a decaying factory as Surge and Data, our electrifying duo. Solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and reveal the secrets hidden within the circuitry. We believe you'll find their story engaging, the challenges satisfying, and the game world visually captivating.

We deeply appreciate your support throughout the development process. Your feedback, encouragement, and shared excitement have fueled our development journey, and we're thrilled to see how you enjoy the game.

Should you encounter any issues or if you have any feedback, please feel free to share them here in the community forum. We're dedicated to ensuring a smooth and enjoyable experience for all our players.

Get ready to plug in, and let the electrical adventure begin!

Happy gaming!

#CircuitBreakout #GameLaunch #SteamRelease
